_comment: Copy this file to deploy.config.json (gitignored) and fill in your values. It is read by tools/setup_agent.py and tools/deploy_skills.py. Command-line flags (--sub/--rg/--agent/--tenant) and environment variables (SRE_SUB/SRE_RG/SRE_AGENT/SRE_TENANT) override these. Keys starting with '_' are documentation only and are ignored by the tools. Never put secrets in this file.

_fields.subscription: Azure subscription ID (GUID) that contains the SRE Agent resource.
_fields.resourceGroup: Name of the resource group holding the Microsoft.App/agents resource.
_fields.agent: Name of the Azure SRE Agent resource to configure.
_fields.tenant: OPTIONAL / informational only. Reminds you which Entra tenant to `az login` into; the tools derive the token's tenant from the subscription, so this value is not required.
_fields.pluginRepo: OPTIONAL. GitHub repository (owner/name) that setup_agent.py installs as a plugin. Default: the `origin` remote of this clone.
_fields.sentinelWorkspaceResourceId: OPTIONAL. Resource ID of the Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace for the Log Analytics connector. Default: the only Sentinel workspace found in the agent subscription.
_fields.codeAccessRepos: OPTIONAL. GitHub repositories (owner/name) that setup_agent.py connects through Code Access, for example the private repository of the DOCX technical report module.
